title: Bounded resumable physical ledger rewrite
scope: Enforce the existing ledger rewrite object budget within dense days and durably resume each physical object mutation/checkpoint without skipping work or overstating progress.
non_goals: Partial W06/F06/F18 physical-progress repair only. No shopper capability/deletion generation, stale-cookie/session/socket revocation, concurrent cross-store serialization, orphan/cache/ring/seen/D1/AE/log/external erasure, approved retention or physical SLA, customer, gate or release acceptance.

Preserve the existing configured scan horizon, inclusive erasure cutoff and active barrier. Do not invent D03 transactional authority, D06 retention/re-entry policy, automatic barrier expiry or an exhaustive-deletion claim.

One production module and one existing fixture only; the unchanged existing ledger suite is compatibility coverage. No new harness, broad suite/build, request-time scorer/SDK changes, deployment, cloud, credentials, customer data, commit/push, destructive cleanup or subdelegation.

criteria.description: rewriteErasures validates a positive integer object budget, opens no more ledger objects than that budget in one invocation even when one day contains more objects, persists validated tenant/tombstone-bound within-day progress, and advances done_through only after every listed object for that day is durably accounted for.

Each mutating object has a durable pre-mutation intent and restartable checkpoint. Definite or ambiguous mutation/checkpoint failures either reconcile exact before/after object state and apply per-visitor counters once, or fail closed on conflicting state. Missing listed objects are checkpointed honestly; retries neither skip remaining objects nor repeat credited removals.

Existing erasure fixture proves a dense-day cap, mid-day restart, before/after ambiguous writes, accurate durable counters, tenant/visitor separation and unchanged post-cutoff rows; existing ledger suite preserves W06.02 barrier/consumer behavior. Worker exact K1 plus app noEmit/scoped diff; independent exact K1 once and frozen source/proof/import pins. No new suite or deployed/SLO claim.

checks.runtime: Installed Node/Vitest; actual ledger erasure and unchanged consumer/writer modules with existing synthetic R2 seams. No external network.
checks.workload: Two existing ledger suites only; grouped dense-day cap, restart/ambiguous mutation/checkpoint, counters and barrier compatibility cases. Worker app noEmit and scoped diff; no engine latency claim.

checks.command: Independent frozen W06.03 actual source and complete worker proof review; exact K1 once; relevant local import graph and physical pins; retain review-v1.md.
checks.runtime: Independent local frozen artifact review; actual module with synthetic R2 only.
checks.workload: C1-C3 bounded physical progress, mutation reconciliation/counters, tenant/visitor/cutoff and W06.02 compatibility; inspect compiler/scoped diff evidence without rerun. No broad/deployed qualification.

dependencies.consumed_output: Existing persistent barrier and delayed-ingestion suppression; overlapping source/fixture proof is retained historically and qualified before edits.
dependencies.rationale: Physical progress extends the same erasure module without reaccepting or weakening the prior replay contract.

dependencies.consumed_output: Future serialized/transactional authority for concurrent cross-store erasure and ingestion.
dependencies.rationale: Bounded per-object R2 recovery does not claim to fence a writer that began before an erasure.

dependencies.consumed_output: Future approved retention, barrier lifecycle and shopper re-entry policy.
dependencies.rationale: This repair preserves the existing configured horizon and active cutoff without choosing expiry or re-entry semantics.

handoff.next_action: Implement bounded restartable within-day ledger rewriting in one production module and its existing fixture; freeze for independent review.
